label: D1 after a rewarded visit to S2 (strongest when S2 was reached by a rare a1 transition)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and essentially only when the reward input is 1 (99.9% recall for D1 & in_rew==1, but only 20% precision there). Never fires at GO/D2 or after an unrewarded trial. Within rewarded D1 steps it is selective for the previous trial having reached S2: D1 & rewarded & prev_state==2 gives dev P=0.41, R=0.81, mass recall 0.86. Magnitude is driven by how the agent got to S2: when a1 led to S2 by a rare transition and was rewarded (the case where a model-based agent should switch to a2), it fires on 99.9% of such steps, at the highest magnitudes, holding 50% of activation mass (corr 0.79). After common a2->S2 rewarded trials it fires weakly and only sometimes, mostly when the value output is low (<7.1) or late in the episode (trials 80-99). Long a2->S2 reward streaks give near-zero activations. Adding (prev_common==0 | value<7.13) raises dev F1 from 0.54 to 0.69, but I recorded the simpler predicate because it is more coherent. All variables used are observed at D1.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & last=a1 S2 r (+6.47), in_rew=1 (+4.95), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 8 (9 = highest) (+4.09), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+3.25), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 7 (9 = highest) (+2.87), prev_action=1 (+2.77). Lower it: prev_state=1 (-7.56), in_rew=0 (-5.83), action=1 (-5.36), phase=D1 & last=a2 S1 r (-4.67).
